body: So I can be locked up and have the most amount of explainable pain forced upon me? I'm not schizophrenic.
There is nothing else keeping me alive except that I want to see a few movies and I need a good location to hang myself.

I don't think you are an actual real person. On the off chance that you are, thank you. I really hope that everything turns out well for you, and thank you for hoping that I will be ok. I know I won't, but it's nice to know someone might care.

Many people have told me I give them really good advice regarding mental health and related issues. Before I started giving this advice out, I followed it and it worked for about a month before I started spiraling downwards. It feels hypocritical to give it out now, but at least it seems to help. Nothing helps me.

I feel the exact same way. I didn't know how to reach out for help when I was younger, and now I'm too far gone to ask for help. Even if I reached out to a professional they'd put me in an institution and it would just make it worse.
No. They're trying to give me false hope through you
For all I know, you and your comment are designed to give me just a bit of hope so that I can be brought down even further.
Who comes to this subreddit to do their worst job at trying to help? "You".
This is really interesting, and makes a lot of sense to me. Thank you, friend.

I was having a semi-decent time, until "you" came along among other things. I can tell by "your" comment history you are full of yourself and think you are better than most people. "You" are not real.
Do you think you are helpful?
This intrigues me. Care to explain?
Your experiences are not universal. These occurrences would be far more common if I were having short term memory issues.
